text:
Jane Patel: Quick sync on ACME POC acceptance checklist + resourcing. I pushed a first-pass below, want quick alignment so SE time is booked.
Mark Liu: LGTM. Can we confirm SE coverage = 8h/week for first 3 weeks then 4h/week after?
Priya Singh: 8h/week ok for integration. We need access to their VPC by day 2 or we hit delays.
Sam Ortiz: Security gating: open items: SSO (SAML), data retention TTL, and BYOK for keys. Need owners for each.
Liz Chen: I'll take retention policy owner. Sam, can you own SSO?
Sam Ortiz: I can. Mark, can you confirm customer legal is ok with BYOK or do they need Redwood-managed keys?
Mark Liu: I'll ask ACME today — likely BYOK request.
Jane Patel: Acceptance criteria (draft):
- 90%+ accuracy on intent classification eval (eval harness attached)
- Demo workflow: 5 representative prompts w/ deterministic outputs (see prompts below)
- Performance: p95 latency < 450ms for 512-token seq under baseline traffic (1 RPS)
- Cost: estimated token cost < $0.012/response for the demo config
Priya Singh: Suggest add regression guard: no >5% drop vs baseline on top-10 prompts.
Jane Patel: Good call, added.
Mark Liu: Timeline proposal:
- Day 0: Kickoff + creds exchange
- Day 1-2: VPC access + sample data ingest
- Day 3-7: Model integration + prompt tuning
- Week 2: Internal eval pass + load smoke test
- Week 3: Customer demo + acceptance sign-off
Priya Singh: Need to book GPU cluster for week 2 load test. Ops-bot, reserve a c4 pool for 24h starting 2223465600?
ops-bot: Reservation created: pool=c4, start=2223465600, duration=86400. Tagging @Priya Singh.
Sam Ortiz: Security questionnaire notes: add to checklist: network diagram, dataflow, retention answers, pen test report.
Liz Chen: I'll compile pen test + SOC2 artifacts and send to ACME by EOD tomorrow.
Mark Liu: Pricing question from buyer: will discounts on reserved capacity apply to POC? We should confirm commercial approach.
Jane Patel: For POC, offer short-term reserved credit (30 days) with usage cap; SE/eng hours billed separately — ok with leadership?
Priya Singh: Fine. We just need a PO or signature to spin reserved nodes.
Mark Liu: I'll get legal and finance to draft a 30-day POC agreement and an up-to $X cap.
Jane Patel: Owners summary:
- SE integration: Priya Singh
- Security lead: Sam Ortiz
- Customer success / artifacts: Liz Chen
- Commercial: Mark Liu
- PM / acceptance: Jane Patel
Priya Singh: One more operational ask: can we collect a sample of 200 typical prompts from ACME to seed prompt tuning? Prefer csv with id,text,label.
Mark Liu: I'll request it in the kickoff email.
Jane Patel: OK — if everyone agrees, I'll convert this thread into a single checklist and calendar invites for the SE blocks. 
Sam Ortiz: Agree. Also please flag any PII in sample prompts before we ingest.
Liz Chen: Will flag and coordinate redaction with ACME.
Jane Patel: Thanks all — I'll post the checklist and invite for day0 in ~30m. :white_check_mark:
